conf.description: Linux syslog cron / JSON rsyslog template: Extract JSON envelope for typed timestamp/severity/host, then the map's own cronie body regex on msg (identical body grammar to the syslog-raw feed -- the JSON template only fixes the envelope, not the body).

conf.comment: linux-syslog / cron / json. The cronJSON rsyslog template gives a typed RFC3339 timestamp and typed severity (the only outcome signal cronie emits), removing the year-guess and PRI/8 derivation the syslog-raw feed needs. msg is still the unparsed '(user) EVENT (detail)' string, so the same cronie body regex from the syslog-raw pipeline runs here too. CMDOUT drop/sample recommendation NOT implemented (no concrete rate given) -- see README gap.

functions.description: record parsing approach and the CMDOUT sampling gap
extract the rsyslog JSON template envelope from _raw into top-level fields
the map's own cronie grammar on msg; trailing ': <errtext>' is a documented extension (see README) since the map names an errno tail but does not give its exact syntax
derive every computed/branched field from the ORIGINAL vendor/regex names before renaming (order rule: compute before rename)
batch rename the remaining clean 1:1 fields
tag event.dataset and drop consumed source/intermediate fields (event.original already holds the pre-parse copy, so _raw and msg are redundant)
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
